name: Michikusa ~Loitering on the Way~
original_name: みちくさ～Loitering on the way～
source:
One day, when Chiaki is on the train, the train suddenly stops for unknown reasons. However, all passengers remain calm since this kind of thing often happens. Of course, he is also calm and thinks about how he kills time. At that moment, he finds a girl walking along the train tracks....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110643/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011259]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
一天，嵯峨智秋乘坐的列车突然因不明原因停了下来。不过，这种情况时常发生，所有乘客都十分平静。他自然也没有慌张，只想着该如何打发时间。就在这时，他发现一名少女正沿着铁轨行走……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110643/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011259]Eroge Shop[/url]]
